ui.$description: UI text. Native 16px; render at whole multiples only.

small.$description: Compact UI text (captions, dense tables). Native 14px.

mono.$description: Code, terminal, tabular data. Native 16px, 9px advance.

display.$description: Big text: wordmark, clocks, splash. Use at 32px and up.

alt-ui.$description: Optional proportional Win95-style UI face. Native 16px.

size.$description: Pixel fonts are bitmaps. Only these sizes are crisp: native sizes and whole multiples of them.

regular.$description: The only weight. Pixel fonts have no bold, and synthetic bold smears; use case, inversion or glow for emphasis.

cell.$description: One character cell. Controls, terminal, tables.

prose.$description: Running text on the web (24px at 16px).
